scenes.headline: Photon Engine
scenes.subtitle: Native vectorized execution for Spark
scenes.narration: Photon is Databricks' C++ vectorized query engine that accelerates SQL and DataFrame workloads.

scenes.headline: What makes Photon fast
items: Written in native C++, not the JVM
scenes.narration: Photon runs as native code, avoiding JVM overhead for query operators. It processes data in vectorized columnar batches that exploit modern CPU instructions. Best of all, it works transparently on existing SQL and DataFrame code.

scenes.headline: Where Photon fits
scenes.narration: You write ordinary SQL or DataFrame code as usual. Catalyst compiles the plan and Photon executes supported operators natively. Unsupported operators quietly fall back to standard Spark.

scenes.headline: Photon vs standard Spark execution

columns.title: Photon
points: Often 2x-10x faster on scans and joins

scenes.narration: Standard Spark executes on the JVM with per-row overhead. Photon processes columnar batches in native code, cutting CPU cycles sharply. On scan- and join-heavy queries this can mean multiples of speedup.

scenes.headline: When Photon helps most
items: SQL analytics and Delta reads and writes
Cost savings from finishing work faster
scenes.narration: Photon shines on heavy aggregations, joins, and big table scans. It accelerates Delta operations and SQL analytics in particular. Faster completion also lowers DBU cost even though Photon carries a rate premium.

scenes.text: Photon speeds up your existing queries with no rewrite, often paying for itself.
scenes.narration: Enable Photon on analytics clusters and let the vectorized engine do more work per CPU cycle.
